recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation or ingredient quality.
recommendations.action: Implement a standardized recipe and portion control system. Conduct daily quality checks on incoming ingredients and prepared dishes. Provide refresher training for kitchen staff on cooking techniques and presentation.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved consistency in taste, quality, and presentation of dishes, leading to higher customer satisfaction and reduced food waste.

recommendations.issue: Perceived poor value for money or uncompetitive pricing.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis of similar restaurants in the area. Evaluate menu item costs and portion sizes to ensure perceived value aligns with price. Consider offering value-added options (e.g., combo deals, loyalty programs) or adjusting pricing for specific items.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer perception of value, potentially increasing sales and customer loyalty.

recommendations.issue: Lack of staff training, understaffing leading to stress, or poor management oversight.
recommendations.action: Implement mandatory customer service training focusing on positive communication, conflict resolution, and proactive guest engagement. Review staffing levels during peak hours and adjust schedules to prevent burnout. Establish a clear feedback mechanism for staff and regular performance reviews.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved guest experience through more attentive and friendly service, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat business.

recommendations.issue: Understaffing, inefficient kitchen/service processes, or poor demand forecasting.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour traffic patterns and adjust staffing levels in both kitchen and front-of-house accordingly. Optimize kitchen workflow and service procedures (e.g., pre-prep tasks, order taking efficiency). Consider implementing a reservation system or waitlist management tool.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer wait times, leading to a smoother dining experience, increased table turnover, and improved customer satisfaction.

recommendations.issue: Unpleasant atmosphere, noise levels, or outdated decor.
recommendations.action: Conduct a walk-through to identify specific areas needing improvement (e.g., lighting, music volume, seating comfort, cleanliness of decor). Implement small, cost-effective updates like fresh paint, new artwork, or improved sound dampening.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more inviting and comfortable dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience and encouraging longer stays.

recommendations.issue: Unspecified issues, potentially related to overall experience, specific incidents, or aspects not covered by other categories.
recommendations.action: Implement a direct customer feedback mechanism (e.g., comment cards, QR code surveys) to gather more specific details on 'other' negative experiences. Train staff to actively listen for and report any unusual or recurring complaints.
recommendations.expected_impact: Identification of previously unknown pain points, allowing for targeted improvements and a more comprehensive understanding of customer sentiment.

recommendations.issue: Insufficient cleaning protocols or lack of attention to hygiene standards.
recommendations.action: Develop and enforce a detailed daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning checklist for all areas (dining room, restrooms, kitchen). Conduct regular spot checks and provide staff training on hygiene best practices.
recommendations.expected_impact: A visibly cleaner and more hygienic environment, boosting customer confidence and satisfaction.
